data.name: Ayodele
data.gender_notes: Ayodele is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayodele is a name of Yoruba origin, meaning 'Jehovah's gift'. It is a popular name among the Yoruba people of Nigeria and is often given to a child as a sign of God's blessings and favor. The name Ayodele carries the meaning “Jehovah's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Yoruba. Parents who choose Ayodele usually hope their child will grow to embody jehovah's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ayodele belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jehovah's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayodele total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: איודלה
in_hebrew.meaning: שם ילד נוצרי, פירוש: "אלוהים הוא שלנו"
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם המקורב לאלוהים, פירוש: "אלוהים הוא שלנו". שם ילד נוצרי, שמקורו בעברית, שמשמעו: "אלוהים הוא שלנו". שם זה קשור לאלוהים, והוא שם המעיד על אמונתו של האב באלוהים.

in_greek.name: Αιοδήλη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αιοδήλη έχει ελληνική ρίζα, με σημασία: "Είμαστε του Θεού". Είναι χριστιανικό όνομα, που δείχνει την σχέση μεταξύ του Θεού και των ανθρώπων. Η ρίζα του ονόματος Αιοδήλη είναι η ελληνική λέξη για "Είμαστε", που χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράφει την σχέση μεταξύ του Θεού και των ανθρώπων.

in_latin.name: Ayodele
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ayodele ex lingua Hebraica, significatio: "Deus est nobis". Nomen Christianum quod manifestat relationem inter Deum et homines. Radix nominis Ayodele est verbum Hebraicum «nous est Deus», quod describit relationem inter Deum et homines.
